name: Raman spectra of macular pigment carotenoids in human blood serum of glaucoma patients, ENIGMA trial, baseline visit (Udensi, Loskutova, Loughman & Byrne 2024)
description: Whole-serum Raman spectra of 21 glaucoma patients of the ENIGMA trial at the baseline visit (the deposit's two baseline folders 'whole Serum baseline_a' and 'whole serum baseline_b'; filename suffixes a-f are repeat measurements of the same patient within the visit). 101 measurement sessions (4-9 per patient; ET015 has 9 across both folders). Horiba LabSpec6 dispersive Raman, native 2,541-point axes spanning 400.8-3,999.4 cm^-1 (~1.42 cm^-1 spacing); the loader interpolates every session onto the common 401-3,999 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (3,599 points), which all 246 valid session exports fully cover, so no extrapolation is involved. Multi-target regression: 11 targets per patient from the deposit's 'OCULAR MEASUREMENTS (ENIGMA).xlsx' baseline sheet -- microperimetry (Microperimetry_glauc severity), OCT (mRNFL_6_glauc_severity, GCC_6_glauc_severity, GCL_6), macular-pigment optical density at 0.23/0.51/0.74/1.02 mm plus MP_Volume6.02, visual acuity (VA), and GAL9. All 21 patients are glaucoma cases (the sheet's Glauc_yes_no column is constant = 1, so it is not a target). group_ids = patient (21 groups): repeat measurements of one patient share the same target row, so grouped k-fold CV is leave-one-patient-out. Intensities are raw LabSpec counts as deposited (per file header DeNoise, Dark correction and ICS correction are all 'Off'); the excitation wavelength is not recorded in the deposit. Both datasets of the deposit share one frozen 9.5 MB Mendeley snapshot mirrored at HTW-KI-Werkstatt/RamanBench (glaucoma_enigma/snapshot/, size + sha256 pinned; the live Mendeley download sits behind a WAF that 403s non-browser clients, hence the mirror). Excluded: 18 sessions of subjects without baseline targets (ET002, ET007, ET018, ET020, ET032, ET034, ET038, ET039, ET043, ET053, ET054), 4 unidentifiable stems ('1', '1_14', '1_10', 'ET0NN'), 1 corrupt export (1.txt, negative wavenumber axis), and 6 .l6s-only files (ET045_a-e: proprietary Horiba binary, and the subject is not in the target sheet). The .l6s twins of the loaded sessions are not parsed either; the .txt export is the canonical text form.

rai:dataCollection: ENIGMA clinical trial (glaucoma, macular pigment carotenoids in blood serum as a measure of ocular health). Whole-serum Raman spectra were recorded on a Horiba LabSpec6 dispersive Raman system; the excitation wavelength is not recorded in the deposit. 101 measurement sessions (4-9 per patient) across the two baseline folders.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: None beyond interpolation onto the common 401-3,999 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (3,599 points). The .txt exports are raw LabSpec6 counts; the deposit applied no baseline correction or normalization.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Clinical target values (OCT, microperimetry, macular pigment optical density, visual acuity, GAL9) measured by the trial's ophthalmic examinations and recorded in the deposit's 'OCULAR MEASUREMENTS (ENIGMA).xlsx' baseline sheet, one row per patient; every Raman session of a patient inherits that row. No human labelling of spectra was involved.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Spectra are derived from human blood serum of trial participants. Subject identifiers are pseudonymised (ET0xx); no direct patient identifiers are included, but the accompanying clinical values are health-related data under applicable data-protection regulations.
rai:dataBiases: All 21 patients are glaucoma cases of a single treatment trial (the sheet's Glauc_yes_no column is constant), so the data describe disease progression and treatment response, not glaucoma-vs-control separation. Sessions per patient are imbalanced (4-9; ET015 has 9, acquired across two visit folders). Spectra of one patient are highly correlated (same blood, same visit), which is why group_ids = patient. Raw intensities are instrument counts; absolute levels are not comparable across acquisitions.
rai:dataLimitations: Single trial, single instrument, single visit: models are not validated against external instruments, cohorts, or a control group. 18 sessions of 11 subjects present in the deposit but absent from the target sheet were excluded, as were 4 unidentifiable stems, 1 corrupt export (negative wavenumber axis) and 6 .l6s-only files (proprietary Horiba binary; the subject ET045 is not in the target sheet). The companion 18-month visit is a separate dataset (glaucoma_enigma_18m) from the same frozen snapshot.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Supports non-invasive screening research for glaucoma and macular pigment status from blood serum Raman spectra; any clinical use requires validation by qualified ophthalmic professionals.
rai:dataUseCases: Multi-target regression of ophthalmic endpoints (OCT RNFL/GCC, microperimetry, macular-pigment optical density, visual acuity) from serum Raman spectra; leave-one-patient-out grouped k-fold CV (21 groups). Longitudinal pairing with glaucoma_enigma_18m for treatment-response modelling.
